posts.cooked: It’s definitely something we’ve talked about in regards to flavor, specifically in character bios or possibly on-card flavor text, but as of now there are no plans to implement love interests as an additional mechanic. posts.cooked: I once had a scenerio where the Freedom Five (minus Absolute Zero, no pun was intended and just now noticed how that worked out) went to stop Baron Blade from destroying Megalopolis, and they passed. Then Grand Warlord Voss was stirring up trouble at Wagner Mars Base, so they promptly responded and somehow got there, not sure how but they did. They were sadly all defeated. So Absolute Zero showed up to avenge his fallen comrades, he also met up with Tempest who was on his way to stop Grand Warlord Voss from taking over any more planets. Fanatic and Ra also show up because Fanatic could sense the disturbance and for whatever reason had Ra with her. They did achieve victory, but at the loss of Fanatic. The remaining trio then met up with The Visionary who informed them about Citizen Dawn and her gang’s plans, so the four of them teamed up to take her out in Insula Primialis before she can move her troops out for her assualt. Victory was the heroes once again, woohoo! And I didn’t have time to go up against Omnitron, but i’m sure it would of taken place in Ruins of Atlantis since it was the only other environment.

I don’t think Wraith seems like the type to love again - though I could totally see them doing a future nemesis-love interest (batman and catwoman anyone?) sort of thing for her since they’ve revealed that she probably gets more than one nemesis.

I think that the love interest thing seems like it’s more fun as back story or if it were in a comic than as a game mechanic though…

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Just because I’m watching this spiral out of control, and I do hate to rain on everyone’s parade: Tachyon and Unity are absolutely NOT romantically involved.

Tachyon had already been married for years by the time she invited Unity to come work for her lab. They butted heads at first, due to their differing ways of approaching issues and Tachyon’s love for order vs. Unity’s love for “just doing things” and not having a thought-out process. Eventually, they became good friends, understanding and respecting each other’s differences and working well together, both in the lab and on the battlefield.

Sorry to be a stick in the mud for your ideas, but I hate seeing so much attention being paid towards a path which will ultimately lead to disappointment.

In exchange for my nay-saying ways, I give you the name of Tachyon’s wife: Dana Bertrand

Enjoy!
